name: cloudbitmaps-workspace
description: Workspace root for the @cloudbitmaps family (not published). Packages live in packages/*.
author: Sharvil Kadam

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && pnpm run typecheck:pkgs && pnpm run typecheck:next
scripts.typecheck:next: node node_modules/typescript-next/bin/tsc --noEmit && node node_modules/typescript-next/bin/tsc -p packages/core --noEmit && node node_modules/typescript-next/bin/tsc -p packages/roaring --noEmit
scripts.site:check: python3 scripts/site-classes.py && python3 scripts/site-links.py && node scripts/site-figures.cjs
scripts.fuzz:deser: pnpm run build && node fuzz/seed-corpus.cjs safe-deserialize && mkdir -p fuzz/crashes && fuzz/node_modules/.bin/jazzer fuzz/targets/safe-deserialize.mjs fuzz/corpus/safe-deserialize --sync --includes fuzz/build -- -max_total_time=${FUZZ_SECONDS:-60} -rss_limit_mb=4096 -print_final_stats=1 -artifact_prefix=fuzz/crashes/
scripts.fuzz:crbm: pnpm run build && node fuzz/seed-corpus.cjs crbm-reader && mkdir -p fuzz/crashes && fuzz/node_modules/.bin/jazzer fuzz/targets/crbm-reader.mjs fuzz/corpus/crbm-reader --includes fuzz/build -- -max_total_time=${FUZZ_SECONDS:-60} -rss_limit_mb=4096 -print_final_stats=1 -artifact_prefix=fuzz/crashes/
scripts.fuzz:index: pnpm run build && node fuzz/seed-corpus.cjs crbm-index && mkdir -p fuzz/crashes && fuzz/node_modules/.bin/jazzer fuzz/targets/crbm-index.mjs fuzz/corpus/crbm-index --sync --includes fuzz/build -- -max_total_time=${FUZZ_SECONDS:-60} -rss_limit_mb=4096 -print_final_stats=1 -artifact_prefix=fuzz/crashes/
